_doc: Preview mode samples (P0-01). Preview mode can't render, so every Draft or Final take it makes is one of these clips from a real OpenSoul render, clearly labelled as a sample. The start card shows the first three clips. Files live in assets/demo_preview/; provenance in assets/demo_preview/PROVENANCE.md. Remove an entry to stop using it.
